ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that monitors data pipelines in DataHub, detects schema drift and broken lineage, uses an evidence gate to verify repairs, and automatically submits real pull requests with write-back capabilities.
ideas.title: DataHub-Sentinel: Autonomous Data Governance & Lineage Healing Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning pattern of building advanced data engineering agents that integrate directly with data governance APIs like DataHub.

ideas.pitch: A developer-focused toolkit that seamlessly handles TOON-native auto-embeddings and vector indexing inside MariaDB to power lightning-fast retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.
ideas.title: MariaDB-TOON: Seamless RAG & Auto-Embedding Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting database-specific hackathon tracks with specialized RAG infrastructure has historically secured top placement prizes.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent workflow that ingests unstructured script data, evaluates market trends, and simulates executive greenlight decisions with detailed data-driven justifications.
ideas.title: CineExec: Autonomous Greenlight Simulator & Studio Executive Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning grand prize formula from agentic cinema hackathons by combining complex multi-agent reasoning with structured media analytics.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered interface that converts natural language data queries directly into interactive Tableau dashboards in seconds using the Tableau REST API and automated data modeling.
ideas.title: Tableau-TextFlow: Instant Text-to-Dashboard Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mimics the exact recipe of previous Tableau DataDev hackathon winners by solving developer friction in Business Intelligence reporting.

ideas.pitch: A frontend-heavy predictive data visualization platform that ingests raw battery telemetry to monitor health degradation and render real-time digital twin analytics.
ideas.title: BatteryTwin: AI Battery Health & Predictive Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust frontend data visualization with complex industrial IoT telemetry, a proven combination for high-scoring frontend and data hackathon entries.
